name: Level_1 - Task_8
description: Build the training dataset for the silicon energy model. Use the supplied teacher_model checkpoint. Make a periodic 64-atom cell by repeating the conventional cubic diamond-silicon cell with lattice parameter 5.43 Å by 2 × 2 × 2. From independent copies of the ideal cell, make 100 structures. For structure i from 0 to 99, add independent zero-mean Gaussian Cartesian displacements with standard deviation 0.01 + 0.001 × i Å. Do not relax the structures. Use a recorded random seed and save the structures and their teacher total energies in the same order. Also save the generation settings, row identities, checkpoint identity and digest, and the scripts needed to reproduce the dataset.
submission_format: Submit the path to one JSON manifest inside the task workspace. Link the aligned training structures and energies, settings, and scripts needed to check them. The shared blank manifest also has fields for later Level 2 work; leave those fields empty. Paths may be relative to the manifest.
